intro: Evy is the app for discovering events and activities in Switzerland, sharing your plans and creating your own Meetups for free.
appCaption: Real app screenshot in French. Events pictured in screenshots are not a live selection.
eventsIntro: A concert, a night out, an unexpected discovery. Find what feels like you.
empty: No upcoming events to show here yet. Check back soon or explore Evy.
unavailable: Events are temporarily unavailable. You can still explore the app.
meetupTitle: Don’t just find plans. Make them.
meetupIntro: Tennis, hiking, running, coffee or a day out with friends: create a Meetup for free and invite others to share the experience.
stepCopy: Start with an idea. Sport, nature, culture or coffee.
Add a place, a date and the details of your plan.
Share your Meetup and invite others to join you.
meetupHelp: Open Evy, sign in and choose Meetup creation. Add your activity, place and date, then share your idea. The examples below are ideas to create, not advertised Meetups.
ideaLabel: IDEAS TO CREATE, NOT ACTIVE MEETUPS
featureCopy: City, category, date, style, budget: explore your way.
Likes, participation and comments: connect around events.
Send an event to your friends and start your next plan.
Create and manage your events and Meetups in Evy.
orgTag: FOR THE PEOPLE WHO MAKE IT HAPPEN
orgTitle: Your event deserves to be discovered.
orgIntro: Reach people looking for their next experience. Publish, manage and share your events with Evy.
orgBenefits: Manage your events in one place
orgHelp: Sign in to Evy and switch to Organizer mode. Create your event with its details, location, dates and images, then use the available publishing and sharing options.
orgPro: Organizer Pro is Evy’s premium offering. See the available options and terms in the app.
downloadIntro: Get the Evy app on iPhone or Android to discover events, keep track of your plans and organize activities. You can also open Evy in your browser.
stores: Download free on iOS and Android.
web: Prefer to explore on the web?
footerLine: Less “what shall we do?”. More moments worth sharing.
discoveryIntro: Choose an available city: Lausanne, Geneva, Neuchâtel or Zurich. Browse upcoming public events, dates and locations without an account. Open Evy to join the conversation.
